title: Putin's post-9/11 proposal to unite against common threats, including cosmic ones

tellings.quote: But on the other hand, there are good and not so good extraterrestrials, right? Some of them might even want to enslave our earth.

plain: Kiran Ilum Xenov, a man who once led a republic inside Russia and says he was taken by aliens in 1997, told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, about an idea from Russia's president, Vladimir Putin. He says that after the September 11, 2001 attacks on the United States, Putin proposed that nations unite against shared threats, including ones from space, since there are good and not so good extraterrestrials and some "might even want to enslave our earth." If true, it would mean a world leader was openly weighing threats from beyond Earth.
